items.title: Carter Benny — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I used to see him around Harlem now and then, but I didn’t know what he was into

ctx.x: Bud Allen, that’s right. Gee whiz, yes, Bud Allen. I wonder what ever became of Bud Allen. I used to see him around Harlem now and then, but I didn’t know what he was into, and I don’t know any other song to which he wrote the lyrics. So that part of my memory is a little clouded.
You mentioned once, and I have to admit I’m embarrassed that I’ve forgotten the gentleman’s name, but you said there was a stride pianist that used to come over from Brooklyn or from . . .
